agentStop.bash: repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$repo" ] && sh "$repo/.okf/hooks/agent_stop.sh" >/dev/null; then :; else echo 'okf-devkit: hook unavailable' >&2; fi; printf '{}\n'
agentStop.powershell: try { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $root) { throw 'git root unavailable' }; & (Join-Path $root '.okf/hooks/agent_stop.ps1'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'hook failed' } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('okf-devkit: hook unavailable'); [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{}'); exit 0 }
